name: Terra Ultima
summary: Step inside the mind of a generative AI, a vast mathematical space where all the memories and stories we shared online are compressed into a statistical resource. This data-driven VR experience reveals how AI models extract and organize our visual culture into a multidimensional geography of meaning and how the space between datapoints promises infinite potential.
